title.description: The title of the page that browses the documents by folder, and the name of the top of the content in the trail of folders over them.

description.defaultMessage: The documents written here, in folders of your own making: what each says, and what search engines show for it.
description.description: The line under the title of the page that browses the content: what it holds. The home page and About Us are not among the documents: they are in the settings.

new.description: The button that opens the form of a new document, and the title of that form's dialog.

newDescription.defaultMessage: Its metadata comes first, and it is filed in the folder that is open. What is written on it is added on its own page, once it is saved.
newDescription.description: The line under the title of the dialog that adds a new document: what the form asks for, where the document is filed, and where the rest is written.

notFound.description: The error shown when an address names a document that does not exist.

page.description: The tab of a document's own page in the admin that holds its metadata and what is written on it.

newFolder.description: The button that opens the form of a new folder, and the title of that form's dialog.

newFolderDescription.defaultMessage: It is made inside the folder that is open.
newFolderDescription.description: The line under the title of the dialog that adds a new folder: where the folder is made.

folderName.description: The label of the field for a folder's name.

rename.description: The action on a folder's row that opens the form of its name.

renameFolder.description: The title of the dialog that renames a folder.

renameFolderDescription.defaultMessage: It stays where it is, with everything in it.
renameFolderDescription.description: The line under the title of the dialog that renames a folder: what a new name leaves as it is.

move.description: The action on a document's or a folder's row that picks it up, to be put down in another folder.

moving.defaultMessage: Moving {name}. Open the folder it belongs in.
moving.description: What the page says over the folders while a document or a folder is picked up to be moved, and what to do next. `name` is the document's title or the folder's name.

moveHere.description: The button that puts what was picked up down in the folder that is open.
